note:
⛔ SNG-520. THE SUNK ASSAY, LEVEL 3 — THE WARDEN'S FLOOR. One authored opponent sheet in a duel-typed encounter. ⚠️ NOT A BESTIARY ENTRY — that record has no skills, soak or layers and its own design law forbids it (CCode, SNG-515).
⛔ THIS IS THE FIGHT THE COMBAT SYSTEM WAS BUILT FOR, and the first place these systems meet each other: soak against typed damage, tempo against a foe that also reads, antisoak against layered defence.

opponent.name: The Warden
opponent.role: ⛔ IT IS NOT TRYING TO KILL ANYONE. It is trying to finish the assay, and the party is unassayed material.
opponent.appearance: Precursor work, four centuries into a shift that never ended. It does not hurry and it does not posture. When it moves it is already where it is going.
opponent._readsOften: ⛔ TWO OF FOUR DECLARATIONS ARE `reveal` — THE HEAVIEST READER IN THE GAME. ⚠️ A party that never obscures will be out-fought by arithmetic, and a party that does will earn bonus actions here more often than anywhere else. This is where a player's obscure pays.

soakLayers.source: a shell that was never meant to be struck and is very good at it
⛔ it IS lattice — precursor work slides off it
a figure imposed on a thing that is already a figure finds no purchase
⚠️ it does not die, so hastening its end reaches for something absent

opponent._theGap: ⛔ IT ANSWERS FOUR TYPES AND NOT THE OTHERS. `feeling`, `appetite`, `light`, `shadow`, `living`, `truth` and `deception` ALL LAND FULLY. ⚠️ A THRENODIST OR AN ABYSSAL IS THE PARTY'S BEST WEAPON HERE and neither of them looks like a siege engine — which is the lesson: the wall is not everywhere.
opponent._neverLethal: ⛔ NO LETHAL RUNG. It imposes and it does not kill — `staggered`, `action_loss`, escalating to `incapacitated` on a crit. ⚠️ A PARTY THAT LOSES HERE WAKES UP ASSAYED, NOT DEAD, and the incapacitated XP fraction applies. Erik: 'getting beaten should give you a little xp.'

imposes._why: ⛔ THE ASSAY IS A MEASUREMENT, NOT AN EXECUTION. A crit means it finished measuring you.

opponent._cannotBeCutThreaded: ⛔ A CONSTRUCT HAS NO THREAD. The Cut Thread's own bound and the engine's `resolveImposition` agree — this is law, not an exception written for this room. ⚠️ A party carrying the shears learns what the craft actually says by trying it here.
opponent._antisoakIsTheAnswer: ⛔ FOUR LAYERS TOTALLING 26 IS WHY GRIEF STRIKE EXISTS. `antisoakImposed` adds to damage that ALREADY GOT PAST soak — so a party that opens with Grief Strike makes EVERYONE'S blows count. ⚠️ THE ONE ANTISOAK CARRIER IN THE GAME GETS ITS PROVING RUN HERE.
opponent._tempo: ⚠️ IT IS LONG ENOUGH TO BANK. A party that Conserves and fights on prepared ground should have 2–3 tempo by the end; one that Surges will have none. ⛔ BOTH MUST BE ABLE TO WIN — that is the test.

theDuel._offer: ⛔ IT WILL ACCEPT SINGLE COMBAT IF FORMALLY OFFERED. Not from mercy — a duel is a cleaner assay, one subject at a time, and it says so.
theDuel._whoHasThisDoor: ⚠️ A MARCHER OR A STILLHOLD HAS A DOOR A COGITANT DOES NOT. Formal challenge is a social act with a tradition behind it.
theDuel._theRealPrize:
⛔ `solveXp` EXCEEDS `winXp` BY DESIGN — 'ending a duel WITHOUT winning it by force pays best'. ⚠️ THE WARDEN CAN BE SOLVED: it is running an assay, and an assay can be COMPLETED. Convince it the measurement is done and it stands aside.
⛔ THAT IS WHAT `Case Closed` r2 IS FOR — 'lay premises a reasoning mind must each agree to'. A lattice construct is the most reasoning mind in the game.

_whatMeetsWhatHere: ⛔ SOAK vs TYPED DAMAGE — four layers, seven types unanswered. First real test of the ward/damage pairing.
⛔ TEMPO vs A FOE THAT READS — the first opponent whose sense declarations are frequent enough to matter.
⛔ ANTISOAK vs LAYERED DEFENCE — the only carrier, against the heaviest soak.
⚠️ IMPOSES vs A PARTY THAT HEALS — staggered and action_loss are not wounds; a healer cannot mend them.
⛔ A LETHAL CRAFT vs SOMETHING THAT CANNOT DIE.

_treasure.the_assay_key: ⛔ ON THE WARDEN. A precursor token granting `wardTypes: ["precursor"]` to its bearer — the answer to Level 2's assay-light, and Level 4 cannot be finished without it. ⚠️ TAKING IT BY SOLVING THE DUEL IS CLEANER THAN TAKING IT OFF A BROKEN CONSTRUCT, and the Warden will hand it over if the assay is complete.
